Superstore Sales & Profitability Dashboard

US retail orders, Jan 2015 – Dec 2018 · 9,993 order lines · 5,009 orders · 793 customers
Built with D3.js · Hover for details · Click bars, states and bubbles to drill down

Sales by state

Click a state to drill into its cities; click again to clear.

Geography drill-down

Region → State → City. Click a bar to go one level deeper.

Sales trend by category

Hover anywhere on the chart to compare categories at that point in time.

Product drill-down

Category → Sub-category → Product (top 15). Click a bar to drill down.

Profit margin by discount level

Click a column to filter the whole dashboard to that discount band.

Discount vs profit margin by sub-category

Bubble size = sales. Click a bubble to drill into that sub-category.

Detail table

Mirrors the product drill-down level. Click a column header to sort.
Data: Tableau “Sample – Superstore” dataset (orders, returns and regional managers), cleaned by the author. Profit margin = profit ÷ sales. Return rate = share of orders with at least one returned item.
